question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A system of society or government in which men hold the power and women are largely excluded from it.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Patriarchy**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Patriarchy**'.
 
• It means 'a social system that gives power and control to men rather than women'. (ऐसी सामाजिक व्यवस्था जिसमें सत्ता तथा नियंत्रण पुरुषों को प्राप्त होता है न कि महिलाओं को, पितृतंत्र; पुरुष-प्रधान सामाजिक व्‍यवस्‍था)
 
 
• *Example: For over a hundred years the country has been ruled by the **patriarchy** of kings.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Patriarchy.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **Matriarchy**: a social system that gives power and control to women rather than men. (सामाजिक व्‍यवस्‍था जिसमें परिवार की सत्ता और नियंत्रण महिलाओं के अधीन होता है (न कि पुरुषों के पास), मातृ-सत्ता, मातृ-तंत्र )
 
• **Masculinity**: qualities or attributes regarded as characteristic of men. (पुंसत्‍व, पुरुषत्‍व, मर्दानगी)
 
• **Patrilineal**: used to describe the relationship between father and child that continues in a family with each generation; something based on this relationship. (पिता और बच्चे के बीच संबंध के लिए प्रयुक्त जो परिवार विशेष में पीढ़ियों चलता रहता है; पितृवंशीय; इस संबंध पर आधारित)
